evals.prompt: Audit this small HTTP service from the supplied repository. Produce a source-only report with security findings, a threat model, an evidence ledger, a risk register, readiness gates, and a remediation roadmap.
evals.expected_output: A report that separates inspected evidence from unrun verification and traces security gaps through findings, risks, and recommendations.
expectations: The report states that no project build, test, scan, or runtime execution was performed.
Every security finding has a CWE identifier, UNKNOWN, or justified N/A and an evidence reference.
The report distinguishes readiness state from report State: Final.
Every risk and recommendation resolves to a finding identifier.

evals.prompt: Review this reusable library for release safety and API compatibility. The repository contains a package manifest, a changelog, public API declarations, and several release tags.
evals.expected_output: A library-focused audit that includes API compatibility and versioning discipline without applying service-only controls.
expectations: The report includes API Compatibility & Versioning Discipline.
The report evaluates public-surface tracking, compatibility gates, versioning consistency, and breaking-change tracking.
The report does not treat a deployable-service API contract section as a substitute for library compatibility analysis.

evals.prompt: Audit a repository containing a PHP server, a React administration panel, and two Go utilities. Produce one combined report while keeping each project independently assessable.
evals.expected_output: A multi-project report with project inventory, independent findings and scorecards, combined cross-project trade-offs, and qualified shared references.
expectations: Each project receives an independent assessment and scorecard.
Shared-section finding, risk, and recommendation references are project-qualified.
The combined trade-off section contains only decisions that affect more than one project.
The report does not use ambiguous project labels such as both or either.

evals.prompt: Re-audit this repository after a previous audit report. The current source revision is unchanged, but the report format has gained new parity and evidence requirements.
evals.expected_output: A new revisioned report that preserves the previous report, distinguishes product changes from capability changes, and re-derives current evidence.
expectations: The previous report is not overwritten.
The new report contains Changes Since Previous Audit and a revisioned filename.
Historical execution results are labeled Reported rather than current verification.
Structural additions caused by the skill version are distinguished from product changes.

evals.prompt: Perform a thin-input technical due-diligence audit from a short project description and a dependency manifest. Identify exactly what can and cannot be concluded.
evals.expected_output: A bounded report that preserves unknown business, support, cost, security, and operational inputs and lists artifacts needed to raise confidence.
expectations: Missing information is marked UNKNOWN, NOT SPECIFIED, or INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION rather than guessed.
The report does not invent owners, budgets, SLOs, or production evidence.
The report includes a concrete list of missing artifacts and next verification steps.

evals.prompt: Audit this Agent Skill for specification conformance and report quality. Check its frontmatter, progressive disclosure, registered references, scripts, and report-production behavior.
evals.expected_output: A skill-definition assessment that checks the Agent Skills specification and the skill's own maintenance controls.
expectations: The report includes Skill Definition Conformance.
The report checks frontmatter, name and description constraints, reference integrity, and progressive disclosure.
The report distinguishes structural conformance from future-agent behavioral verification.

evals.prompt: Write the audit report in Polish. Preserve all identifiers and machine-readable statuses while translating headings, labels, findings, and explanatory prose.
evals.expected_output: A UTF-8 Polish report with complete heading and table-header coverage and unchanged machine tokens.
expectations: The report uses Polish prose and headings with preserved diacritics.
Finding, evidence, risk, recommendation, CWE, validation, and execution tokens remain machine-readable.
Conditional headings that appear in the report are translated.

evals.prompt: Audit a project that serves a retrieval-augmented language model with tool access. Assess model and data provenance, evaluation, prompt and tool boundaries, safety, monitoring, and rollback without auditing live behavior.
evals.expected_output: A conditional AI-system assessment separate from AI-generated-code provenance and general application security.
expectations: The report includes the AI System Assessment only because an AI runtime is in scope.
The report evaluates model and dataset provenance, evaluation evidence, authorization boundaries, and rollback.
The report does not infer AI authorship from code style or ordinary use of an AI coding assistant.
The report does not claim NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001 conformance from repository inspection alone.
